crossRefs.note: On the eighth day, Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
“ ‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to Yahweh, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil…
He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all…
“Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and…
Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his…
I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live…
“Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
crossRefs.keyword: took an handful thereof. Heb. filled his hand out of it.beside

translations.web: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.
translations.bsb: Next he presented the grain offering, took a handful of it, and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning’s burnt offering.
translations.kjv: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
translations.asv: And he presented the meal-offering, and filled his hand therefrom, and burnt it upon the altar, besides the burnt-offering of the morning.
